question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing center midfielder, Dave is playing left back, and Eve is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) left winger
(C) center midfielder
(D) left back
(E) striker
solution:
Each row lists positions in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve.
Initial: right back | left winger | center midfielder | left back | striker
1. Claire swaps with Alice: center midfielder | left winger | right back | left back | striker
2. Dave swaps with Claire: center midfielder | left winger | left back | right back | striker
3. Claire swaps with Dave: center midfielder | left winger | right back | left back | striker
4. Dave swaps with Alice: left back | left winger | right back | center midfielder | striker
5. Alice swaps with Claire: right back | left winger | left back | center midfielder | striker
Eve is the striker, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
